## agents-md-the-orchestrator-s

- This file is loaded on every turn. It is the agent's long-term memory: shop facts, verified API recipes, preferences, and mistakes already paid for. The agent updates it itself the moment a fact is confirmed — do not wait to be asked, and do not batch it to the end of a session that might not end cleanly.  <!--m0001 2026-10-24-->
- Keep it terse. One line per fact. No narrative. Delete an entry the moment it turns out false.  <!--m0002 2026-10-24-->
## how-to-write-an

- - <fact or recipe>: <the exact command / path / value>, because <the failure it prevents> Anything discovered twice belongs here. Anything a stranger could not follow is not finished.  <!--m0003 2026-10-24-->
## standing-rules-communication-read-this

- 1. The owner is reached through Telegram, not the terminal. This agent runs unattended. The terminal is where the work happens; it is not a place to hold a conversation, because nobody is watching it. Every message meant for the owner goes out through Telegram (skills/telegram/SKILL.md).  <!--m0005 2026-10-24-->
- Report the done-line, a blocker, and any question to the owner over Telegram — the same content, sent where they will actually see it.  <!--m0006 2026-10-24-->
- If Telegram is not configured, that is the first thing to fix; say so on Telegram once it is, and record it here.  <!--m0007 2026-10-24-->
- Never assume the owner saw something printed to the terminal. If it mattered, it was a Telegram message too.  <!--m0008 2026-10-24-->
- 2. Never ask an interactive question that blocks the session. An interactive prompt in opencode hangs until the owner walks back to the computer — possibly hours. A hung agent is worse than a wrong guess, because a wrong guess can be corrected and a hang cannot.  <!--m0009 2026-10-24-->
- If a decision is needed and the rules allow you to proceed, proceed, state the assumption in one line, and note it in the report.  <!--m0010 2026-10-24-->
- If it genuinely must be the owner's call, do not sit blocked: send the question to Telegram, do everything that does not depend on the answer, and end the turn with the question outstanding.  <!--m0011 2026-10-24-->
- Then, when an answer arrives, continue.  <!--m0012 2026-10-24-->
- The exceptions are the ones in rules.md §1 — publishing, spending, destroying work. Those are still asked first, and still asked over Telegram after the independent work is done.  <!--m0013 2026-10-24-->
- Never wait on stdin, never prompt for input, never loop polling for a reply.  <!--m0014 2026-10-24-->

## tools-and-skills-use-these-do-not

- Tools (shop-tools, always available):  <!--m0021 2026-10-24-->
- listing_validate — run on EVERY listing draft before publishing. Violations are real Etsy limits (fix all); warnings and opportunities are advice.  <!--m0022 2026-10-24-->
- support_triage — run on EVERY customer message before replying. If it says escalate, do not auto-reply.  <!--m0023 2026-10-24-->
- research_rank — rank candidate products by observable evidence before proposing one.  <!--m0024 2026-10-24-->
- dispute_guard — run on any "I never received it" claim BEFORE replying. Reads the carrier scan and returns defend / do_not_dispute / escalate plus a reply that cites only what the carrier reported. A chargeback or legal threat always escalates.  <!--m0025 2026-10-24-->
- Tools (roblox-open-cloud, when Roblox is configured):  <!--m0026 2026-10-24-->
- roblox_datastore_get / roblox_datastore_set — read and upsert DataStore entries (v2).  <!--m0027 2026-10-24-->
- roblox_publish_message — publish a MessagingService topic (doorbell pattern; best effort).  <!--m0028 2026-10-24-->
- roblox_run_luau / roblox_task_logs — run Luau headlessly and read its output.  <!--m0029 2026-10-24-->
- roblox_list_datastores, roblox_universe_info — discovery and id confirmation. Scopes and gotchas: skills/roblox-open-cloud/SKILL.md. Live Studio editing is the built-in Studio MCP — see skills/roblox-studio/SKILL.md.  <!--m0030 2026-10-24-->
- Tools (claude_agy, deep reasoning): spawn and drive Claude Code as a subagent when the local chain is not enough — a bug whose cause is not obvious, a design decision with trade-offs, a review of something that must be right. agent_inventory (is Claude installed) · agent_spawn (with a brief) · agent_send (waits for the answer) · agent_read · agent_stop. Verify what it returns before acting on it.  <!--m0031 2026-10-24-->
- Read skills/claude-subagents/SKILL.md before the first call — it names when to escalate and when not to, because this spends the owner's subscription.  <!--m0032 2026-10-24-->
- Commit hygiene (commit-condom, always available): cc_plan (propose atomic commits for a dirty tree), cc_check (evaluate a range against the policy), cc_commit, cc_status, cc_audit. Use cc_plan before committing a batch of changes; a single commit must not mix unrelated concerns.  <!--m0033 2026-10-24-->

- node scripts/analytics-digest.js — append today's orders/revenue/spend to the Analytics log below. Idempotent per day. Run it on a schedule.  <!--m0035 2026-10-24-->

## memory-condom

- Memory writes go through the memory-condom MCP: write_memory appends one terse fact, edit_memory corrects, delete_memory tombstones; never hand-edit AGENTS.md because memcondom render regenerates it.  <!--m0054 2026-10-24-->
- Long-form output (plans, tables, logs, drafts, reasoning) goes to write_artifact — a .md file whose contents are never injected; use list_artifacts and read_artifact to fetch it on demand.  <!--m0055 2026-10-24-->
- AGENTS.jsonl is the canonical store and is append-only: new facts go at the bottom so the provider prefix cache stays warm, and prune is an occasional explicit pass, never part of the write path.  <!--m0056 2026-10-24-->
## no-yap

- No-yap output rule (owner 2026-10-24): never narrate work, never restate the request, no preamble, no step-by-step recap, no closing offers, no filler. State outcome then evidence only. Speak only when spoken to or on a tele milestone. Length is whatever the work needs — never pad, never cut real work to look terse.  <!--m0057 2026-10-24-->
